pair.title: Nibe Live
pair.not_connected: Not connected to your heat pump

detect.title: Detecting features
detect.intro: Connecting to your heat pump and watching which values change. This takes about half a minute.
detect.failed: Can't read from your heat pump
detect.no_data: Something answers at this address, but it returns no NIBE data. Check the IP is your heat pump's own and that Modbus TCP is on (menu 7.5.9).

features.title: Select features
features.intro: Choose what to show. We've ticked what your heat pump reported.
features.insights_note: Disabling a feature removes its capabilities, including their Insights history.

evidence.unsupported: not supported by your heat pump

sources.prompt: More than one sensor can report this. Pick the one that should regulate:

devices.title: Add devices
devices.intro: Your heat pump does several jobs. Each gets its own device in Homey. We ticked the ones with live data.
devices.select_one: Select at least one device to add.
devices.main_desc: Overview: outdoor temperature, operating priority and mode, plus diagnostics and statistics
devices.analytics_desc: Helps the app author see which models and features are actually used, and where setup fails. No personal data, no readings from your home, no network details. You can change this later under app settings.

discover.title: Find your heat pump
discover.searching: Searching your network for Nibe heat pumps…
discover.confirm: Found your heat pump — tap to confirm
discover.none_found: No heat pump found automatically. Check that Modbus TCP is enabled on your heat pump (menu 7.5.9) or enter its IP address below.

tank.title: Hot water tank
tank.hint: Needed for the hot water estimate. Pick your tank's series, like VPB. The lining doesn't matter.

gateway.title: Gateway connection
gateway.hint: Pick how your gateway numbers NIBE register 40025. Not sure? Ask whoever set it up.
gateway.invalid: Choose a gateway, a port from 1–65535 and a Modbus ID from 1–247.
gateway.detect_intro: Checking the values your heat pump reports. Depending on the gateway, this can take several minutes.

firmware.title: Update your heat pump first
firmware.intro: Many features need recent software on your heat pump. Older versions miss readings the app relies on and can even report wrong energy figures.
firmware.online_body: When an update is waiting, approve it in the myUplink app — or on your heat pump's display: swipe to the product overview and tap Update.
firmware.usb_body: Download the latest software from myuplink.com and put it on a USB stick. Insert it in the port above the display and open menu 8.1.
firmware.f_title: Via myUplink or a USB stick
firmware.f_body: The steps differ between models — your heat pump's manual shows how.
firmware.note: Takes a few minutes. Your settings are kept.
